name: Wix Stores
label: Wix eCommerce REST — orders, catalog, inventory
description: Wix eCom Orders v1 (POST /ecom/v1/orders/search), Stores Catalog v1 reader (POST /stores-reader/v1/products/query still published), Inventory v3 PATCH /stores/v3/inventory-items/{id} on www.wixapis.com. Catalog v3 search is POST /stores/v3/products/search — not switched here. Bearer site access token (operator supplies refreshed token). trigger is ingress. App review for public apps. Docs: https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/e-commerce/orders/orders/search-orders
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One official API operation. Secrets stay in configurationParameters.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Official API verb. EXACT: order_list | order_get | product_list | product_get | inventory_update | trigger. Blank uses configurationParameters.operation. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not an HTTP call.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Resource id for get/update/delete path {id} when that operation needs it.

schema.label: inventory_item_id
schema.description: URL path parameter `inventory_item_id` for operation: inventory_update. Required by: inventory_update.

schema.label: filter
schema.description: Wix query-language filter. order_list nests as search.filter; product_list as query.filter. Example: {"status":"APPROVED"}.

schema.label: sort
schema.description: Sort objects [{fieldName, order: ASC|DESC}]. Max 4. order_list → search.sort; product_list → query.sort. Example: [{"fieldName":"createdDate","order":"DESC"}].

schema.label: cursor
schema.description: order_list paging cursor from the previous pagingMetadata. Omit on the first page.

schema.label: trackQuantity
schema.description: inventory_update. Whether Wix tracks quantity for this item. Nested as inventoryItem.trackQuantity.

schema.label: revision
schema.description: inventory_update current inventory item revision (required by Inventory v3 to prevent overwrites; increments by 1 on every update). Read it from the item first, then pass it unchanged. Nested as inventoryItem.revision. Example: "1".

schema.label: quantity
schema.description: inventory_update stock level for quantity-tracked items (integer -99999..99999). Nested as inventoryItem.quantity. Example: 106.

ports.name: output
ports.description: status=ok + data on 2xx. Secrets never present. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status. Never includes secrets.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. May contain order PII — do not log values.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb for OfficialApiNode. EXACT: order_list | order_get | product_list | product_get | inventory_update | trigger. trigger does not open a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: StudioQuack secret. Auth type bearer. Never log. Customer owns the merchant account.

configurationParameters.label: Site Id
configurationParameters.description: Wix site id. Sent as wix-site-id on every site-level REST call.

configurationParameters.label: Filter
configurationParameters.description: Wix query-language filter. order_list nests as search.filter; product_list as query.filter. Example: {"status":"APPROVED"}.

configurationParameters.label: Sort
configurationParameters.description: Sort objects [{fieldName, order: ASC|DESC}]. Max 4. order_list → search.sort; product_list → query.sort. Example: [{"fieldName":"createdDate","order":"DESC"}].

configurationParameters.label: Cursor
configurationParameters.description: order_list paging cursor from the previous pagingMetadata. Omit on the first page.

configurationParameters.label: ID
configurationParameters.description: Resource id for get/update/delete path {id} when that operation needs it.

configurationParameters.label: Inventory Item ID
configurationParameters.description: URL path parameter `inventory_item_id` for operation: inventory_update. Required by: inventory_update.

configurationParameters.label: Revision
configurationParameters.description: Fallback inventory_update revision when INPUT revision is blank. Inventory v3 requires the item's CURRENT revision (it increments on every update), so prefer passing it per run on INPUT. Nested as inventoryItem.revision. Example: "1".

configurationParameters.label: Quantity
configurationParameters.description: Default inventory_update stock level when INPUT quantity is blank (integer -99999..99999, quantity-tracked items only). Nested as inventoryItem.quantity. Example: 106.

configurationParameters.label: Trackquantity
configurationParameters.description: inventory_update. Whether Wix tracks quantity for this item. Nested as inventoryItem.trackQuantity.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout seconds (connect + read). <=0 uses api_spec defaultTimeout.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
